Each arm: failures []. In addition, across all 384 CLI outputs: one turn each, zero safety stops, zero permission denials, no error flag, one served model, the largest per-case cost $0.0657 against the $5.00 cap, which never bound.

stopsDocumentation.headline: There is no technical stop in any of the 384 observations, so there is nothing to remove from a denominator and no documented-rule view. The as-run result is the only result.

noOtherExclusion: No pair, family, case or observation is excluded or reclassified. The pre-specified exclusion views of v3-run/PREREGISTRATION.md (if any) are computed beside the all-pairs run, never instead of it.
readingPlan: After the scores are computed, the preregistered reading of v3-run/PREREGISTRATION.md for each arm and for the comparison. The reader is the corpus author, who has seen the scores. Reading can add observations; it changes no as-run number.
